description: Hunter F.56 on stands outside the Nehru Museum at IIT Kharagpur, badge of the Operational Conversion Unit (Young Uns), nose camera fitted. warbirds.in gives BA355 (delivered Oct 1960); bharat-rakshak gives BA-335 (delivered 10 Mar 1960) at the same museum - serial needs on-site check. The campus Spitfire XVIII HS669/TP387 was exported in 1994.
